- Smart home hub: Oolaa smart mirrors support Matter, Zigbee, Bluetooth, Wi-Fi (KNX on request) and integrate directly with Apple Home, Google Home, Amazon Alexa and Xiaomi — no extra hub required. Voice control via Google Assistant (Cantonese supported). Installed in the foyer, the mirror acts as the whole-home command centre.
- Bathroom models: IP65 rated; defroster and motion detection available. Oolaa is a bathroom-TV specialist, supplied to Sun Hung Kai (SHK) projects in Hong Kong.
